description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveDuration class within the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin. It models different types of leave durations, including full day, half day, and specified time, with methods for validation and property management.

classes.name: LeaveDuration
classes.description: Represents the duration of a leave, including type and optional start/end times, with validation based on the duration type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LeaveDuration object with type, and optionally from and to times.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the leave duration type with validation against allowed types.

methods.name: getFromTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the leave period, applicable only if type is 'specify_time'.

methods.name: setFromTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the leave period.

methods.name: getToTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the leave period, applicable only if type is 'specify_time'.

methods.name: setToTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the leave period, enforcing that toTime is after fromTime.

methods.name: isTypeFullDay
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration is full day.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration is half day (morning or afternoon).

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayMorning
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration is half day morning.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayAfternoon
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration is half day afternoon.

methods.name: isTypeSpecifyTime
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration is specified time.
